justification.issue_description: maxResponseSize is not enforced for unbuffered chunked Node responses.
justification.evidence: The prompt requires an ETOOLARGE error when an incoming response payload exceeds the configured byte threshold, without limiting that requirement to buffered responses. In the submitted code, src/node/index.js counts response bytes only under `if (buffer)` (around lines 1193-1215), while the `if (!buffer)` branch immediately calls `this.callback(null, this._emitResponse())` (around lines 1251-1259).
justification.verdict_reasoning: This is a documented behavior gap, not an undocumented test convention: an unbuffered response is still an incoming response payload and must be terminated when it exceeds the configured limit. The verifier failures are direct assertion failures in those two cases, so FAIL_MISSED_REQUIREMENT is the appropriate primary verdict.
